title: A new image model and more reliable DeepSeek responses
summary:
A new image model and WebSim model selection joined steadier text streaming, more community projects, and less imaginative feed counters.

Added the Azure-backed `gptimage` model for images up to 1024 pixels on a side. DeepSeek v3 responses now use `reasoning_content` when the answer is absent from `content`.

OpenAI-compatible streams now format each SSE delta, including DeepSeek reasoning inside `<think>` tags when an answer follows. Ad handling moves to a streaming wrapper, and the text server’s in-memory response cache was removed.

The WebSim HTML generator now accepts a model query parameter and favors single-file HTML. The MCP package’s `npx` entry was also corrected for ES modules, so its CLI starts the server directly.

daily.title: Generate with gptimage
daily.text: Generate images with the new `gptimage` model, with a maximum side length of 1024 pixels. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).

daily.title: Choose a WebSim model
daily.text: Pass a `model` query parameter to the WebSim HTML generator to choose the model behind your generated page. It defaults to `openai-large`.
